- Build a complete, playable 3D 1v1 shooter game for phones and tablets.

- Built a browser-based first-person arena shooter named NEON DUEL with a best-of-three match, keyboard/mouse controls, and touch twin-stick controls.

- Created a self-contained game in `index.html` using Three.js from a CDN, with arena geometry, HUD, enemy AI, shooting, reloads, rounds, and responsive mobile controls.

  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

  mouseup [button]            press mouse up

  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie
  cookie-clear                clear all cookies

  localstorage-get <key>      get a localstorage item by key
